headline: Divided Fronts See Fresh Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the ledger records a marked quickening at Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle. Weathered Expanse has risen to 68 strategic-base events in 24 hours, with ten in the latest two hours and 18 in six; its holdings stand at five Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. Stonecradle reaches 20 daily events, including nine in two hours and 17 in six, while its nine bases remain divided six to three in the Wardens’ favor. Stlican Shelf, quiet in the previous report’s latest window, has resumed action with three events in two hours and eight in six, amid 55 across the day. Linn Mercy remains busy at 18 daily events, though only two came in the latest two hours. Farranac Coast shows six daily events and three in six hours, but none in the latest two, while its two-to-nine split still favors the Colonials. Godcrofts has emerged as another active sector, posting nine daily events and two in the latest two hours, with one Warden and eight Colonial bases. Callahan’s Passage remains a major casualty front, but no base events have been logged in the latest 24 hours.
